Creative Systems

GHS

GHS supports vessel stability, loading and salvage analysis using geometric ship models.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a vessel model

Use the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended GHS preview, build a vessel model; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Evaluate loading conditions

Start from the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended GHS preview, evaluate loading conditions; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Review stability criteria

Begin with the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended GHS preview, review stability criteria; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
